title: In the presence of Jehovah

lines.text: In the presence of the King.

chords:
[Verse]
In the [D]presence of Je[G]hovah,
[D]God Almighty, [A]Prince of Peace,
[D]Troubles vanish [G]hearts are mended,
In the [A]presence of the [D]King.
lyrics:
[Verse]
In the presence of Jehovah,
God Almighty, Prince of Peace,
Troubles vanish hearts are mended,
In the presence of the King.
